author: anosvoldigod
quote: Except for the graphics nothing about it is better than previous GTAs and even that is only because of realism not for any stylish choice. Crash animations are bad, It is more lucia centric story, and you cannot do many things one could do in gta here, I feel like the map is made for gta online, if time will tell if even that is good. My advise is that this is a hype game, not worth $100 price.
